problem: Services had very different load patterns, and scaling and updating many services became a heavy burden.
title: Segment consolidates destination microservices back into one service
context: Segment had split each customer-data destination into its own service and repository.
decision_made: Move back from many destination microservices to a single monolithic service.
action_taken: Published an account of the change in July 2018.
observed_outcome: Segment described the consolidation as the right choice for this platform, while keeping microservices elsewhere.
lessons: Microservices can add operational cost when many services share the same shape of work and need to change together.
limitations: Self-reported by the company. Specific to Segment's destinations platform and team size.

claims.claim_text: Segment moved from many destination microservices back to a single service.
The company presented the consolidation as successful for this platform.
